description: Image Description: The image displays a simple, minimalist icon of a pair of scissors. The scissors are depicted in a stylized, monochrome outline form, with two blades crossing each other and connected by a pivot point at the center. The handles are curved and symmetrical, forming loops that suggest where fingers would be placed for use. The overall design is clean and abstract, with no additional details or shading, emphasizing the basic shape and function of the scissors. The icon appears to be a vector graphic
